alignments.note: Substantival article keeps 'the things that', headed on the nominal word (rules 22, 32).
Adverbial predicate carries the supplied copula (rule 53).

Support-verb frame for φρονέω: 'mind' is the meaning-bearing complement and takes the head (rule 17); the frame's own supplied noun licenses the following 'on', which stays inside the unit (rule 21), the object being accusative and having no case for it to realize (rule 106).

Second substantival article, parallel to s001. The repeated 'on' is the frame's preposition written again over the second coordinate member and is a helper on the member it introduces, never `added` (rules 21, 103). Reading that second 'on' as a discontinuous second realization of the frame on s003 remains defensible.
Prepositional predicate carries the supplied copula (rules 31, 53).

review_notes: Both τὰ + ἄνω and τὰ + ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς analysed alike (rule 24).
The repeated 'on' at t011 was checked against rule 86: a function word repeated over a coordinate member is a helper, not `added` (rule 103).
